engine.notes: Los Angeles clusters its improv on Vermont Avenue (Pack, WGIS, Improv-LA and Impro Theatre within two blocks), with UCB on Franklin and the Groundlings on Melrose; Burbank, Santa Monica and Culver City each have one working room. ComedySportz LA's site returned server errors and Flappers' and Improv Trick's sites could not be read, so they are unlisted; The Elysian now teaches mostly clown.

entries.name: The Groundlings Theatre & School
entries.summary: The character-and-sketch improv powerhouse founded in 1974, with a company of 40, shows like Cookin' with Gas and a school running Intro, Basic, Intermediate and Lab tracks toward the Sunday Company.
entries.schedule: Shows weekly; fall 2026 classes start October 7-21; new classes posted Tuesdays 1pm
signals: Core Track: Basic, Intermediate, Improv Lab
Alumni include Ferrell, Wiig and McCarthy
entries.reasons: Fifty years in its own theater, a famous alumni list, a structured track to the company and October 2026 class dates on the school page.

entries.name: Impro Theatre
entries.summary: LA's narrative long-form company, nearly four decades old, improvising full-length plays in the styles of Shakespeare, Twilight Zone and more at its Vermont Avenue studio and Dynasty Typewriter, with the Impro Theatre School.
entries.schedule: October 2026 shows include Twilight Zone Unscripted (Oct 7) and Shakes' Peers (Oct 4)
entries.reasons: Decades of standing, a studio of its own, a current October 2026 calendar and a school; class levels are less explicit on the site than the show calendar.

entries.name: Pack Theater
entries.summary: An independent comedy theater at 1615 N Vermont Avenue with improv, sketch, stand-up and variety six nights a week and affordable classes in improv, sketch, TV writing, clowning, stand-up and character.
entries.schedule: Shows six nights a week; class and audition news posted August 2026
signals: Teachers from SNL, Netflix and Adult Swim
entries.reasons: A busy independent venue with its own stage and a broad class menu, current to August 2026; younger and less tiered than the Groundlings or UCB.

entries.name: M.I.'s Westside Comedy Theater
entries.summary: A comedy club, theater, bar and training center in a Santa Monica alley at 1323-A 3rd Street, open seven nights with the short-form flagship Mission: IMPROVable every Friday, classes and an improv jam.
entries.schedule: Shows 7 nights; Mission: IMPROVable Fridays 10pm; Pretty, Pretty Pony Thursdays 8pm
entries.reasons: A venue of its own with a nightly calendar current for October 2026, a flagship weekly improv show and classes, though class levels are not spelled out online.

entries.name: Improv-LA
entries.area: Los Feliz, Silver Lake and Burbank
entries.summary: A four-level improv school with studios in Los Feliz, Silver Lake and Burbank, free level showcases each term and the monthly Toast! alumni jam at The Clubhouse Theater.
entries.schedule: Showcases through November 2026; Toast! Improv Jam every third Sunday 8:30pm
signals: Founded by a Guinness record holder for longest improv show
entries.reasons: Current dates, a four-level ladder, three locations and a monthly jam; it has no theater of its own and relies on partner venues for performances.

entries.name: World's Greatest Improv School (WGIS)
entries.summary: A women-led long-form school at 1615 N Vermont Avenue teaching Level 1, Level 2 (Game of the Scene) and Level 3 (Harold), plus advanced courses, with every multi-week class ending in a show and $16 drop-ins.
entries.schedule: Fall 2026 classes run late August to November; drop-ins $16
signals: Also runs NYC and online classes
entries.reasons: A clear three-level ladder with fall 2026 dates and student shows, in a shared venue; its standing rests on teachers rather than a long history.

entries.name: LA Connection Comedy Theatre
entries.summary: Kent Skov's short-form house since 1977 at 3435 W Magnolia Boulevard, running a Saturday ladder of kids, teen, rookie, JV and all-star improv shows and a four-week intro class that feeds its performing groups.
entries.schedule: Saturdays from noon to 9:30pm; $10 tickets; 4-week intro class
signals: Saturday show ladder from rookies to all-stars
entries.reasons: One of the oldest improv rooms in LA with its own theater and a Saturday show ladder, but a thin class offering and no dates posted.

entries.name: Improv for the People (IFTP)
entries.summary: A membership-style improv school at The Pico Theater, 10508 W Pico Boulevard, where flex-level classes run month to month like a gym, with beginner-friendly entry points and a Saturday Night Improv Show.
entries.schedule: Four classes a month per membership; Saturday Night Improv Show
entries.reasons: A venue of its own and a weekly show, with an unusual rolling membership model instead of a level ladder; dates are not posted term by term.

entries.name: Fanatic Salon Theater
entries.summary: A 50-seat indie performance home at 3815 Sawtelle Boulevard with improv, stand-up, solo shows and music, a Saturday-morning improv drop-in taught by Second City e.t.c. founder Jeff Michalski and teen improv.
entries.schedule: Improv drop-in Saturdays 11am; Thursday open mic 7pm; calendar runs to December 2026
signals: Teachers include Second City e.t.c. founders
entries.reasons: A permanent small venue with a current calendar and a weekly drop-in, but no leveled program and improv is one strand of a mixed bill.

entries.name: Michelle Danner Acting Studio (Improv LA)
entries.summary: An acting studio at 10820 Washington Boulevard running six-week adult improv courses in person and online, plus youth improv, each ending in a class show for friends and family.
entries.schedule: Adult in-person Mondays 10:30am and Thursdays 6:30pm; online Saturdays, Sundays and Tuesdays
signals: Class show at the end of each course
Part of an established acting school
entries.reasons: Regular weekly sections from a long-standing acting school, but improv is an elective there, with no shows, no jam and no stated levels.
